description: Link protocol v1 vectors produced by the TypeScript client (client-typescript/scripts/vectors.ts). Byte strings are lowercase hex unless the field name ends in B64u or the spec puts them in JSON as b64u.

valid.name: the second member claimed the primary
a member carrying a field the protocol does not define (kind): signed, and otherwise ignored
unplaced: version 1 with no relay yet
placed: version 2 with the relay set

invalid.name: signature by the primary's own node key, not the network key
network is the primary's node id (the old rule)
member id not derived from its ed25519
primary is not a node id
primary is not a member (the network id)
primary is not a member (a member removed)

acceptance.name: another primary, the same network key
valid but signed by another network key

placedAccepted.name: any relay URL of the rule
a non-ASCII host, a port and a query

refused.name: relay: a host that is not one

parse.name: a non-ASCII relay with a port and a query, percent-encoded as UTF-8
any order, a displayed lower-case code, a parameter it does not know, an empty part
r percent-encoding that is not UTF-8

steps.description: stamp T - W, recorded W before the responder started: refused
a member 9 minutes slow, right after the restart: accepted
the same bytes again, a replay: refused
stamp T again from a new ephemeral: refused
an 8-byte payload, the roster version alone: refused as malformed
a stamp ten years ahead: refused, and nothing stored
a stamp exactly W ahead of the responder: accepted, and stored as it is
a stamp W + 1 ahead of the responder: refused
the initiator leaves the roster: its stamp is retained
and is admitted again: its stamp is restored
a replay of an init from before its removal: refused
a fresh init after its return, stamped after the restored stamp: accepted
